Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Subprocessor list & SOC 2 status (post-demo)

Hi Lena / Bob —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope for our production control plane; I attached a short SOC 2 summary and our current subprocessor list.
- Primary subprocessors for the Acme use case: Google Cloud (GCP) for compute & storage, AWS S3 for backups, and Segment for telemetry. Full list in attached PDF.
- You asked about GDPR/HIPAA controls: we encrypt data at rest and in transit, support customer-managed keys via KMS, and offer a Private deployment option if you need dedicated VPC.

Requested next steps: 
1) Please confirm whether the attached subprocessor list covers your procurement/security needs or if you need additional evidence (e.g., full SOC 2 report or whitepaper).
2) I'll kick off the vendor security questionnaire — attaching an editable VSQ XLSX for your team to review and for us to complete.
3) Intro to our security lead (CC'd internally) if you'd like a technical call to walk through data boundaries.

I'll coordinate answers from our security and SE teams and get this back to you by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0123

Marissa / Neha —

Quick update and answers to the questions Lena raised: 

1) Telemetry/third parties: We currently send aggregated usage metrics to Segment for product analytics. No raw customer PII is sent to Segment. The only third parties that may receive identifiable data are: Google Cloud (compute & managed DBs), AWS S3 (encrypted backups), and Stripe for billing (if customers opt into Redwood billing). Full list is in the attached PDF.

2) Data flows & regions: Primary compute runs in GCP us-west2; backups are in S3 us-west-2 encrypted with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS). We support customer-managed keys via KMS for Private deployments.

3) SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Neha — can you send a templated NDA + DocuSign link to Acme? If procurement needs faster triage, I'm available to join a 30-min call this week to walk through controls (suggest Wed/Thu).

4) Vendor questionnaire: I've started filling the attached VSQ (see highlighted tabs). I'll complete the security controls and encryption sections by EOD today and loop Neha for legal/controls confirmation.

Next steps I will own: finish the VSQ, share completed copy with Acme, and provide the DocuSign NDA link (Neha to send).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
